author: Alex Carter - Sports Editor
title: Arsenal Draw With Como as Bruno Guimaraes Makes Debut
text:
Arsenal secured a 4-3 penalty shootout victory over Como following a 1-1 pre-season draw at the Emirates Stadium. The fixture featured the debut of £75m signing Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United, an opening goal from Myles Lewis-Skelly amid ongoing transfer speculation, and a tactical equalizer by Martin Baturina.
Bruno Guimaraes Debuts Amid High-Stakes Roster Construction Heading into the final stretch of the pre-season calendar and with the Community Shield clash against Manchester City looming, Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta integrated high-profile reinforcements. According to BBC Sport , the club officially announced the £75m acquisition of Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United on Saturday before introducing him to supporters ahead of a friendly against Dortmund.
According to Daily Mail Sport , Newcastle initially viewed Arsenal’s pursuit as a tactical process driven primarily by the player’s agent, with the club maintaining he was not for sale below an escalated valuation. Yet, sporting director Andrea Berta ultimately moved the needle to land the 28-year-old midfielder, who expressed a desire to compete for major titles.
Tactical Integration and Experimental Lineups at the Emirates Arteta deployed an experimental starting XI against Como, handing opportunities to five academy graduates. Among them was Myles Lewis-Skelly, whose long-term stability in north London has drawn intense scrutiny following reported interest from Premier League rivals Chelsea and Manchester United, per BBC Sport . Lewis-Skelly rewarded that faith by breaking the deadlock in the first half with a composed finish.
Como responded after the break through an excellent strike from Martin Baturina, neutralizing Arsenal’s advantage before Arteta introduced his anticipated core unit around the hour mark. Guimaraes entered the fray at half-time, wearing the number 39 shirt and immediately drawing a roar from the home crowd. His first defensive action—a vital recovery tackle to snuff out a Como counter-attack before recycling possession to goalkeeper David Raya—underscored his combative, all-action profile.
“Let’s see. He only had three training sessions. But he looked good,” Arteta said in his post-match news conference, as reported by BBC Sport . “He was really pushing to play some minutes today. I think he wanted to get his debut and the feeling of playing in front of our fans immediately. You sensed immediately a really strong connection and a player that is going to make us better without a doubt.”
Squad Depth, Market Valuation, and Commercial Logistics While Arsenal integrated Guimaraes, the club recently lost out on long-term target Morgan Rogers to Chelsea in a deal valued at £117m, after valuation metrics diverged significantly with Aston Villa, according to Daily Mail Sport .
Photo: bbc.co.uk Following a stagnant second half affected by substitutions and a cooling break—during which Kai Havertz, Noni Madueke, and Cristhian Mosquera registered unsuccessful attempts—the match moved straight to a pre-agreed penalty shootout. Guimaraes converted his spot-kick with composure, helping the Gunners seal a 4-3 victory from twelve yards and capping off a turbulent yet productive evening of preparation.
